priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Stop logging issued authentication tokens
findings.body: Every call with a usable bearer/session token writes that credential in plaintext to stdout. In deployments where stdout is collected or accessible to operators or other services, log readers can reuse the token to impersonate its owner.

findings.title: [P1] Restrict post-login redirects to trusted destinations
findings.body: The function passes returnUrl directly to location.assign, which accepts absolute cross-origin URLs. If this value originates from a login query parameter, an attacker can send authenticated users to a phishing site after login. Accept only validated same-origin URLs or allowlisted relative paths.
